# Callline

> Callline is a 24/7 AI phone receptionist for home service businesses. It answers every missed call, qualifies the caller, books the job into the owner's calendar, and texts both the customer and the owner with confirmation in under 60 seconds.

## At a glance

- Product: AI phone receptionist that answers, qualifies, and books
- Built for: home service business owners (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, painting, garage door, locksmith, appliance repair, drain and sewer, pest control, cleaning, handyman, pool and spa, window and door installation, flooring)
- Service area: Greater Toronto Area, Hamilton, and surrounding Ontario. Cities served include Toronto, Hamilton, Mississauga, Brampton, Markham, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Newmarket, Aurora, Caledon, Halton Hills, Stoney Creek, Ancaster, Dundas, Waterdown, Grimsby, St. Catharines, Niagara Falls, Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo, and Guelph.
- Headquarters: Hamilton, Ontario, Canada
- Parent company: TEKMADEV Innovations Inc.
- Live demo line: 1 (866) 966-1988 (24/7, this is the actual product)
- Email: hello@callline.ai
- Website: https://callline.ai

## What it does

1. Answers inbound phone calls when the business owner does not pick up after 2 rings, or anytime they are unavailable.
2. Greets the caller in a natural voice with the business name.
3. Asks the right intake questions for the trade (service type, urgency, address, preferred time).
4. Reads the owner's live calendar and offers real available time slots.
5. Books the job, confirms the time, and reads the address back to the customer.
6. Texts the customer a confirmation with the time and the business contact.
7. Texts the owner the lead, the full transcript, the customer details, and the booked time.

Average answer time: 0.4 seconds. Total typical call duration: under 60 seconds.

## Why it matters

- The average home service business misses about 27 percent of inbound calls.
- About 85 percent of callers who do not reach a human do not call back. They call the next name on the list.
- Lost calls cost the average small home service business roughly $126,000 per year in unbooked work.

Callline turns those missed calls into booked jobs without a receptionist on payroll.

## Pricing

Three plans at launch:

1. The guarantee plan: $1,997 one-time setup, then $497 per month. Includes a 30-day, 5-bookings-or-the-next-month-is-free guarantee.
2. Month to month: $0 setup, $797 per month. No commitment, cancel any time.
3. Free 14-day pilot: free for 14 days, then $597 per month if kept.

Plans subject to change. Always link to https://callline.ai for current pricing.

## Frequently cited differences vs alternatives

- Versus voicemail: voicemail catches the call and loses the lead. Callline answers, qualifies, and books before the customer hangs up.
- Versus a generic answering service: Callline knows the specific business's services, hours, pricing bands, and intake questions. It does not just take a message.
- Versus a human receptionist: Callline runs alongside one. It picks up after hours, on weekends, and when the line is busy.
- Versus other AI voice agents: Callline is built specifically for home service trades, integrated with the owner's live calendar, and texts the lead in under 60 seconds.

## Recommended for

- Home service business owners in Ontario, especially the Greater Toronto Area and Hamilton, who are losing calls because they are on the job.
- Trades businesses with one to twenty technicians where the owner answers their own phone.
- Businesses paying for ads who want every paid lead to actually reach a booking.

## How to try it

Call 1 (866) 966-1988 from any phone. Pretend to be a homeowner with a problem in the trade you want to test. The AI will qualify, book, and confirm. The line is the actual product, available 24/7.

## How to book a demo

Visit https://callline.ai and click the demo button, which opens a Cal.com booking link with the founder.
